name: WP Google Review Slider
author: jgwhite33

sections.description:
Display Google Reviews on Your WordPress Site in Under 2 Minutes — Stored Locally for Fast Page Speed.

WP Google Review Slider downloads your Google Business Profile (formerly Google My Business / GMB) reviews and saves them directly in your WordPress database on your own server. Unlike widgets that call external APIs on every page view, your site serves Google reviews locally for instant loading, better Core Web Vitals, full caching compatibility, and a smooth visitor experience.

Whether you run a storefront, a multi-location company, an e-commerce shop, or a service area business (SAB) without a physical street address, this Google reviews WordPress plugin makes it effortless to showcase verified 5-star customer testimonials, customer-uploaded review photos, and a Google rating summary badge anywhere on your site.

Why Choose WP Google Review Slider?

  • Works With Service Area Businesses (No Address Needed): Many Google review plugins fail when a business hides its street address on Google Maps. WP Google Review Slider supports service area businesses, physical storefronts, and Google Product Reviews.
  • Multi-Location Download Support: Add multiple Google business locations and download reviews for each location into your WordPress database.
  • Two Flexible Download Methods:
    1. Google Crawl Method: Search for your business or enter a Place ID/search term to download up to 40+ newest or most relevant Google reviews — including customer-uploaded review photos — with no API key required.
    2. Official Google Places API: Connect your Google Places API key to download your 5 most helpful or newest reviews and keep them automatically updated every day via cron.
  • Fast Local Storage (utf8mb4 Emoji Support): Reviews and customer photos are stored locally in WordPress so your pages stay fast and never break if an external service is slow.
  • Built-In Review Analytics Dashboard: Track your average Google star rating, 1-to-5 star breakdown, review volume timeline, rating trends over time, and positive/negative keyword word clouds right inside wp-admin.

Key Features (Free Version)

  • Responsive Review Slider, Carousel, Grid & List: Showcase Google reviews in an animated horizontal slider or a multi-row, multi-column responsive grid.
  • Two Modern Template Styles + Live Preview: Choose between Style 1 (classic speech bubble) and Style 6 (modern review card layout) using a tabbed template editor (Style, General, Filter, Badge) with live AJAX preview.
  • Google Summary Rating Badge: Display a customizable Google rating badge on the left, right, or above your reviews — or display the badge standalone. Customize business photo, name, colors, border, drop shadow, and “Based on…” / “Review us on…” text.
  • Customer Review Photos & Lightbox: Download user-submitted photos attached to Google reviews and display them in a click-to-enlarge image lightbox.
  • Review List Management: View all imported reviews in one place. Easily hide/show individual reviews, edit reviewer avatars and review dates inline, or delete reviews.
  • Smart Template Filtering: Filter reviews by minimum star rating (e.g., only 4-star and 5-star reviews), hide reviews without text, sort by newest or random order, and select which saved Google location a template displays.
  • Full Design Customization: Customize star colors, verified review badges, reviewer last name format (full name, hidden, or initial), avatar style (real photo, mystery icon, initials, or hidden), Google icon link, font sizes, background/text colors, border radius, and custom CSS.
  • Advanced Slider & Layout Controls: Configure autoplay, slide speed and delay, show/hide navigation arrows and dots, swipe support on mobile, one-review-per-slide mobile mode, equal-height review cards, and expandable Read More links.
  • Display Anywhere: Embed unlimited review templates on any page, post, sidebar, or footer using the WP Google Review Slider block, a shortcode, a WordPress widget, or a PHP template function.
  • WordPress Dashboard Widget: See your latest downloaded Google reviews right on your WordPress admin dashboard.

Why Display Google Reviews on Your WordPress Website?

Google Business Profile reviews are one of the strongest trust signals online. Displaying real, verified Google reviews, star ratings, and customer photos alongside your calls to action, booking forms, and service pages builds instant social proof, reduces buyer hesitation, and improves conversion rates.

Check Out Our Other Free Review Slider Plugins

  • Facebook & X (Twitter) Reviews
  • Yelp Reviews
  • TripAdvisor Reviews
  • Airbnb Reviews
  • Thumbtack Reviews
  • Zillow Reviews
  • WooCommerce Product Reviews

Upgrade to WP Review Slider Pro for More Features

Want to combine reviews from every platform, automate review requests, and unlock AI-powered insights? Upgrade to WP Review Slider Pro:

  • 150+ Review Sites & Platforms: Automatically download and aggregate reviews from Google, Facebook, Yelp, TripAdvisor, Airbnb, VRBO, WooCommerce, Trustpilot, Zillow, Thumbtack, Amazon, Etsy, Fiverr, Houzz, Nextdoor, Booking.com, Expedia, Angi, HomeAdvisor, BBB, Capterra, G2, Glassdoor, Healthgrades, Zocdoc, Avvo, DealerRater, CarGurus, OpenTable, DoorDash, Uber Eats, Fresha, Reviews.io, Yotpo, Birdeye, Clutch, and 110+ more!
  • Custom Review Sources & AI Import: Create custom review sources with your own platform name and logo for any site not listed, and even use AI to extract and import reviews automatically.
  • Combine Multiple Locations & Platforms: Mix Google reviews from multiple locations and 150+ review sources into a single unified slider or grid, or filter dynamically by location, Post ID, Category, or custom tags.
  • AI Review Summaries & Deep AI Analysis: Generate an AI-powered “Customers Say” summary for your template header or badge, run full AI Sentiment & SWOT Analysis reports (with themes, pain points, personas, and action items), and generate AI Owner Responses in one click.
  • 15 Review Template Styles & Masonry Grids: Unlock 15 customizable template layouts (including media cards and WooCommerce product layouts), Masonry grids, continuous-scroll carousels, custom responsive breakpoints, and child-theme template overrides.
  • Interactive Front-End Header, Search & Pagination: Add a front-end search bar, sort dropdown, rating/source filter, tag filter pills, Load More button, Endless Scroll, or numbered pagination above your reviews.
  • 7 Summary Badge Styles, Floating Badges & Slide-Out Drawers: Choose from 7 badge designs, pin floating badges or review pop-ins to the corner of your site, and open a slide-out or pop-up review drawer when clicked.
  • Front-End Review Submission Forms & Smart Review Gate: Collect new customer reviews with customizable forms (stars, thumbs, or smileys, custom fields, photo/video uploads, and reCAPTCHA). Route happy reviewers to Google/social pages while capturing low ratings privately.
  • Automated Review Request Emails (Autoresponders): Automatically send branded review request emails after WooCommerce orders complete (or on custom schedules) with open/click tracking.
  • Shareable Social Media Review Cards: Turn your best reviews into high-resolution PNG graphics for Instagram, Facebook, X, LinkedIn, or print — with Google Fonts, size presets, and Unsplash background search.
  • Live Review Email Signatures: Generate HTML or dynamic image email signatures for Gmail, Outlook, and Apple Mail showcasing your live star rating and review count.
  • Google Rich Snippet Schema (JSON-LD) & Product XML Feeds: Output valid JSON-LD AggregateRating schema markup for Google Search star snippets and generate Google Shopping Product Ratings XML feeds.
  • Auto-Translate, Webhooks, CSV Import/Export & White-Label: Automatically translate reviews with Google Translate API, send new reviews to Zapier, Make, or n8n via webhooks, get low-review email alerts, sync with TrustGuide, bulk-edit tags/categories, import/export CSVs, and enable Agency White-Label Mode.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the wp-google-reviews folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install WP Google Review Slider directly from Plugins → Add New in WordPress.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Open WP Google Reviews in your WordPress admin menu.
  4. Go to Get Google Reviews to add your business location(s) and download your reviews via Google Crawl or the Google Places API.
  5. Check the Review List and Analytics tabs to view and manage your imported reviews.
  6. Go to Templates, create a review slider, grid, or summary badge, then insert the WP Google Review Slider block or paste the shortcode into any page, post, or widget area.
sections.faq:
Are Google reviews stored on my server?

Yes. After you download reviews from Google, they are saved in your WordPress database on your own server (including local copies of customer review photos). Your site serves those stored reviews locally instead of calling Google every time a visitor loads a page, which keeps your site fast and cache-friendly.

Does this work for service area businesses without a physical address?

Yes! Many Google review plugins only work for businesses with a public street address. WP Google Review Slider supports service area businesses (SABs) as well as physical storefronts and Google Product Reviews.

Can I download Google reviews from multiple locations?

Yes. You can add multiple Google business locations on the Get Google Reviews page and download reviews for each one. In the free version, each review template can filter by a chosen Google location. In WP Review Slider Pro, you can also combine multiple locations and platforms into a single all-in-one slider or filter dynamically by Post ID and tags.

What is the difference between the Google Crawl method and the Google Places API?

  • Google Crawl Method: Lets you search for your business or enter a Place ID/search term to download up to 40+ newest or most relevant reviews (plus customer-uploaded photos) without setting up a Google Cloud API key.
  • Google Places API Method: Uses your official Google Places API key to fetch up to 5 of your most helpful or newest reviews and automatically checks for new reviews daily via a background cron job.

Can I display customer photos from Google reviews?

Yes. When you download reviews that include customer-uploaded images, the plugin saves them and displays thumbnail previews inside your review slider or grid. Visitors can click any photo to view it in a full-size lightbox popup.

Can I filter out low-star reviews or hide specific reviews?

Yes. In your template Filter settings, you can set a minimum star rating (for example, only show 4-star and 5-star reviews) and hide reviews without text. You can also click the visibility icon on the Review List page to hide any individual review at any time.

Can I display a Google review summary badge?

Yes. Every template includes a Badge tab that lets you display a customizable Google rating summary badge on the left, right, or top of your reviews — or hide the reviews to display a standalone badge.

How do I request a new feature?

We are always looking for features to add! Post on the WordPress.org support forum or contact us on the WP Review Slider website.

Where do I report security bugs found in this plugin?

Please report security bugs found in the source code of the wp-google-places-review-slider plugin through the Patchstack Vulnerability Disclosure Program. The Patchstack team will assist you with verification, CVE assignment, and notify the developers of this plugin.
